components.title: Temporal adapter public boundary
components.rationale: src/index.ts is the package export surface for adapter, worker, workflow and activity runtime pieces.

components.title: Temporal provider adapter
components.rationale: TemporalAdapter implements provider-facing start/cancel/signal/status behavior; ObservedTemporalAdapter decorates it with telemetry.

components.title: Temporal client boundary
components.rationale: Owns concrete Temporal client interactions used by the adapter.

components.title: Temporal worker host
components.rationale: Creates and hosts Temporal workers and binds runtime activities/plugins.

components.title: RunPlan workflow runtime
components.rationale: Temporal workflow implementation for plan execution, layers, signals, lifecycle, cancellation and deterministic state.

components.title: Temporal activities + dispatch
components.rationale: Activity factory, step dispatch, validation, gateway activity and plan-artifact reads used by Temporal workers.

components.title: Temporal step plugin boundary
components.rationale: Defines plugin profile and runner boundaries used to keep step-specific execution outside the generic adapter core.

components.title: Temporal policy mapping
components.rationale: Maps admitted plan policy into Temporal-specific options; modeled AS-IS without claiming runtime authority beyond source evidence.

components.title: Run-state command circuit breaker
components.rationale: Protects run-state command writes from cascading provider/runtime failures.

components.title: Temporal observability + error policy
components.rationale: Provider-specific telemetry, error translation and plan-ref capacity SLA policy.
